description: Angular component for configuring calculated fields filter settings, including UI interactions, form management, and overlay handling.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldsFilterConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing calculated fields filter configuration, including form controls, overlay interactions, and value change propagation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up form and overlay, and handles input data.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the filter configuration and updates the form and display.

methods.name: toggleCfFilterPanel
methods.description: Opens overlay panel for filter configuration.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Resets form to current config and closes overlay.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Applies form changes to filter config and closes overlay.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets form to initial filter configuration.

methods.name: cfFilterConfigEquals
methods.description: Checks equality of two filter configurations.

methods.name: updateCfConfigForm
methods.description: Updates form controls with given filter config.

methods.name: cfConfigUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal filter config and propagates change.

methods.name: updateButtonDisplayValue
methods.description: Updates button label based on current filter config.

methods.name: cfFilterFromFormValue
methods.description: Converts form value to filter config object.
